title: All disclosed contacts for identified labor clients
question: Whom did the lobbyists contact and what did they request?
finding: 1,482 contact entries include monitoring, support, opposition and requests for delay.
how: Read every current activity row against its filing ID. Match client names with the existing labor-name rules and independently recognized Sailors, Musicians and United Service Workers organizations. Keep mixed trade association–union clients as filed. Never infer the client from the official contacted.
limits: A payment is compensation reported by a lobbyist for a client across the filing period. The reports do not allocate it to a vote, official or contract. Congressional lobbying on behalf of the City is a separate system. Public testimony and specified bargaining with the City have reporting exemptions. An absent contact does not establish that a party took no position. The membership and client-name screen can miss coalitions named only for a campaign or a law firm.
